name: Vinnie’s Tomb: Chapter One - The Road to Vinnie’s Tomb
summary: Vinnie’s Tomb: Chapter One – The Road to Vinnie’s Tomb is a surreal point-and-click adventure game released in 1997 by Reldni Productions. Players guide Vinnie, a hapless clown-like character, on a bizarre quest to locate his ancestor’s tomb, hidden somewhere within an abandoned electronics store. Mixing absurd humor, hand-drawn art, and deliberately offbeat puzzles, the game delivers a very much self-aware parody of 1990s adventure tropes. Originally distributed as a free PC title, it has since become a cult curiosity among collectors of obscure shareware and indie releases.
